messages:
alex-customer: Hey, we rotated our IdP signing cert yesterday and now our users see 403 on SSO. ACS endpoint is https://app.example.com/saml/acs — we didn't change SP config. Can you help? /cc @maria-support

maria-support: Thanks @alex-customer — can you share any SAMLResponse sample (redacted) and confirm whether RelayState is present? Also paste the Assertion Recipient if possible.

sso-bot: Detected IdP cert rotation for idp.acme.example at 2026-03-17T10:12:04Z (automated alert)

alex-customer: Pasted redacted base64 here: https://paste.example.com/redacted-samlresponse — RelayState present. Our logs show "Recipient mismatch" and an HTTP 403 in the SAML handler. Assertion looks signed but also has encrypted Assertion element.

jon-eng-saml: pinging in to triage. "Recipient mismatch" usually means the Assertion's Recipient attribute doesn't match the SP's registered ACS URL. After a cert/metadata change some IdPs canonicalize ACS with query params or trailing slash. Can you paste the Assertion Recipient value from the decoded SAML?

alex-customer: Assertion Recipient: https://app.example.com/saml/acs?tenant=acme — our SP registration is https://app.example.com/saml/acs (no query). We never had ?tenant before. Release notes from IdP mention "canonicalize ACS with RelayState" in their v2.4.

maria-support: That explains the Recipient mismatch. Two immediate options: (1) Update SP to accept ACS with querystring (server-side change) (2) Ask IdP to re-export metadata with the ACS exactly as registered (no query). Short-term we can suggest an nginx rewrite to strip the query for the saml handler. Do you want the snippet?

alex-customer: Yes please, short-term workaround ASAP.

jon-eng-saml: Try this minimal nginx rewrite before the SAML handler:

```
location = /saml/acs {
  if ($arg_tenant) {
    return 307 $scheme://$host/saml/acs;
  }
  proxy_pass http://saml-handler;
}
```

This redirects requests that include the ?tenant param to the canonical ACS without query, preserving method. It's a quick stopgap while we get IdP metadata fixed.

devops-oncall: FYI I've opened ENG-1234 to add flexible Recipient matching in our runtime so the SP can accept known query param variants safely. Assigning to jon-eng-saml, priority P2.

jon-eng-saml: Note: I also noticed the IdP metadata we imported had a UTF-8 BOM which caused our metadata parser to treat some ACS values as relative in a prior case. If the IdP export included a BOM, it can mangle the ACS value during ingestion. Recommend requesting a clean metadata export (no BOM) and confirm the EntityDescriptor/AssertionConsumerService Location exactly matches the SP value.

maria-support: I'll ask them for a fresh metadata file without BOM and to confirm whether their rotation included a metadata re-render that added query params. Also suggested they can (a) rollback the cert rotation for a short window if possible, (b) apply the nginx rewrite, and (c) provide the redacted SAMLResponse if issues persist. Sending checklist to Alex now. :thumbsup:

alex-customer: Thanks — applying nginx rewrite now and requesting new metadata from IdP. I'll report back in ~10 minutes. Really appreciate the quick triage.

maria-support: Please update this thread with the result. If the nginx trick doesn't work, attach the saml handler debug log and the decoded Assertion (redact NameID) and we'll escalate to oncall runtime team.

alex-customer: Update: nginx redirect applied, a few users can sign in now. Still seeing sporadic 403s for some tenants. I'm keeping the metadata request with IdP open and will paste the new metadata when available.

maria-support: Good progress. Keeping ENG-1234 linked here; we'll revisit once new metadata is in. If they send a new metadata file, prefix it with md5: for quick fingerprint check.

jon-eng-saml: Also pulling a short checklist for eng to follow when they send metadata: 1) verify no BOM, 2) check ACS Location exact match, 3) confirm signing cert thumbprint present, 4) validate Assertion Recipient and Audience, 5) test with a decoupled saml tracer. I'll attach the checklist to ENG-1234.

maria-support: Closing the immediate support loop; will reopen if more 403s after metadata swap. :white_check_mark:"
